# Sunny Shop

> > Sunny Shop is an e-commerce platform offering electronics, beauty & health products, and food & drinks with specialized category navigation.

The shop features a hierarchical catalog structure spanning multiple product verticals including electronics (computers, gaming accessories), beauty & health items (perfumes, men's grooming products), and consumables (beverages). Many categories appear to be in development with empty product catalogs.

## Key Topics

- Electronics
- Beauty & Health
- Food & Drinks
- Gaming Accessories
- Computer Products
- Men's Grooming
- Ladies Perfumes
- Hair Styling
- Beer & Beverages
- Empty Catalog Navigation
- Product Categories
- E-commerce Platform

## Electronics

- [Computer](https://shop.sunny.eu/electronics/computer): Computer category page under Electronics at Sunny shop
- [Gaming Accessories](https://shop.sunny.eu/electronics/gaming/accessories): Gaming accessories category under Electronics at Sunny shop

## Beauty & Health

- [Ladies Perfumes](https://shop.sunny.eu/beauty-health/perfumes/ladies): Ladies perfumes category in Beauty & Health section
- [Hair Dryers (Men's Care)](https://shop.sunny.eu/beauty-health/men-care/hair/hair-dryers): Men's hair dryers category in Beauty & Health section

## Food & Drinks

- [Beer](https://shop.sunny.eu/food-drinks/beer): Beer category page under Food & Drinks at Sunny shop
